# Next Notes

> Next Notes is one familiar companion starting on your Mac. It helps you dictate where
> you work, keep meeting notes, and review proposed follow-ups. "Home helper," "office
> associate," and "meeting partner" describe moments of help from the same app, not
> separate assistants. The site's conversations are illustrative examples.

Website: https://next-notes.com/
Source and product status: https://github.com/spyhack225/next-notes
Download for Mac: https://github.com/spyhack225/next-notes/releases/latest/download/NextNotes.dmg
License: https://github.com/spyhack225/next-notes/blob/main/LICENSE

## What is available on Mac

- Push-to-talk dictation: hold a key, speak, release, and the cleaned-up text returns to
  the app that had focus when you started. Personal dictionary corrections and per-app
  formatting are available.
- Meeting recording and notes: with calendar access and recording enabled, Next Notes
  can notice eligible meetings, record microphone and system audio without a meeting bot,
  transcribe the conversation, and write notes. The meeting card offers Record now and
  Skip.
- One Mac companion: the same Next Notes conversation can answer questions and, with
  the needed permissions, inspect or act in Mac apps. Its home and office examples start
  when the person asks; broad autonomous life management is still in development.
- Proposed follow-ups: when the relevant Google Workspace integration is enabled,
  Next Notes can draft actions from meeting notes for the person to review and approve.
  A draft is not a sent message or a completed task.

## Availability and data handling

- The Mac app requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon. The core app needs no
  account or subscription. It is free and open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later.
- Speech recognition and meeting notes have local processing options. Optional cloud
  models and connected services send the information needed for the feature the person
  chooses; "local by default" is not a claim that no data can ever leave the Mac.
- The iMessage command channel and agent-initiated phone calls are not available today.
  A separate Windows dictation app builds and runs its tests in CI, but has not been
  tested in a real microphone-and-key session on Windows hardware; the Mac meeting and
  companion features are not in that app.
